# WO-002: "Is this you?" to-dos from the exposure scan, plus CLI docs
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via tools/vendor.sh)
In-house reviewer on acceptance: automation-engineer (Theo Park); qa-security if anything touches storage.

## Goal
1. When `freemyid exposure` (src/freemyid/engine/exposure.py) finds a POSSIBLE match (match level possible) on a site, create the same review to-do that a normal `scan` creates for a possible match (look at how the runner/scan path creates REVIEW_MATCH to-dos and reuse that code, do not duplicate it), so the person sees "Is this you?" on the dashboard right away instead of after the next run. No duplicate to-dos if one is already open for that listing. CONFIRMED matches and "check by hand" sites create no new to-do.
2. Document the JSON schemas `checklists/1` and `checklist/1` (from src/freemyid/checklist_state.py) in docs/CLI.md, in the same style as the other schemas there, and mention the new to-do behaviour in docs/EXPOSURE.md.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- New tests (dev fixture brokers / fakes only, never real sites): a possible match creates exactly one REVIEW_MATCH to-do; re-running the scan does not add a second; a confirmed match and a check-by-hand site add none; practice mode and consent rules are unchanged.
- `PYTHONPATH=src <venv>/bin/pytest -q tests/test_exposure.py` and the new tests pass; ruff clean on changed files.
- docs/CLI.md lists both checklist schemas with field names matching the code.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- src/freemyid/engine/exposure.py
- tests/test_exposure.py
- tests/test_exposure_todos.py
- docs/CLI.md
- docs/EXPOSURE.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
Everything else: models.py, storage/, runner.py (call into it, don't edit it), cli.py, the wizard, network/netpolicy code, brokers/ data.

## Check-in plan
After the first session the owner reads VENDOR_STATUS.md and the diff and answers questions. Then a final check-in when done, then in-house review.
